project.title: Bankdrop Financial Crime Paper 1
project.repository_purpose: Privacy-clean transparency and reproducibility support for corrected deterministic Phase 1-4 analysis and publication-safe derived aggregate analyses.
project.empirical_scope: Deterministic Phases 1-4 only. No Phase 3b, Phase 4b, Phase 5, or LLM-assisted empirical analysis is included.
project.authorship_status: Final author names, order, affiliations, identifiers, and contribution statements will be supplied by the authors.

data_boundary.corpus_type: Controlled research vault containing Markdown notes and PNG screenshots
data_boundary.interpretive_boundary: Observed online content, not a transaction ledger

screening_audit.interpretation: Unique text hashes support duplicate sensitivity only and are not a verified eligible-record denominator.

validation.status: Invalidated and withdrawn on 2026-07-25 because 14 ineligible internal project notes entered the original validation sample. A new eligible-corpus sample and fresh independent coding are required before human-validation statistics may be reported.
validation.reason: Original sampling frame included internal administrative and research documents excluded from the corrected 980-note evidence corpus.

repository_release.rights: No reuse licence; all rights reserved.

ai_authoring_assistance.disclosure: OpenAI Codex was used as an assistive tool to support the development and organisation of the project’s GitHub repository, including assistance with code, testing, workflow orchestration, documentation, and reproducibility safeguards. It was also used to support the preparation and formatting of the workbook used for the intercoder reliability assessment. Codex did not generate coding responses, independently classify or interpret the evidence, assess coder agreement, resolve disagreements, or participate in the adjudication process. All coding, intercoder reliability assessments, resolution of discrepancies, interpretation of findings, verification of outputs, and final methodological and substantive decisions were undertaken by the named authors. The authors critically reviewed and validated all AI-assisted outputs and retain full responsibility for the accuracy, integrity, and conclusions of the research. Codex was not treated as an author and did not perform literature discovery, citation checking, or the drafting or editing of the manuscript or submission materials.
included_support: preparation and formatting of the intercoder-reliability workbook
ai_authoring_assistance.author_responsibility: Named authors retain responsibility for the human coding, reliability assessment, adjudication, interpretation, output verification, and final decisions.

derived_analysis.status: Completed deterministic descriptive post-processing of controlled Phase 3 outputs; not a Phase 5 or LLM-assisted empirical stage.

populations.exact_text_unique_status: Duplicate-sensitivity denominator only; not a verified final eligible population.

derived_analysis.interpretation_boundary: Co-occurrence, source concentration, AML-candidate overlap, and exploratory functional groupings are descriptive of captured records and do not establish sequence, common actors, transactions, causation, a completed service chain, or market prevalence.
